covers: Wall Street open and the late JSE session, Wednesday 11 November 2026 (since the 15:20 midday update)
headline: Nasdaq up 1.3% at the open as CoreWeave jumps 16% and Nvidia rebounds; JSE All Share slips 0.9% to 113,655 with Woolworths down 8%
summary: The JSE All Share was at 113,655.36 late in the session, 0.9% below Tuesday's close, with Woolworths down 8.1% and Naspers (-2.6%) and Prosus (-2.3%) still the main drag, while the rand eased to R16.59/$ (LRC Market Dashboard and LRC Stock Scanner quotes from Yahoo Finance, 11 Nov 16:27-16:43 SAST). Wall Street opened higher, with the Nasdaq up 1.3% at 25,398.80 and the S&P 500 up 0.8% at 7,584.15 shortly after the open as CoreWeave (+16.4%), Micron (+7.0%) and Nvidia (+2.5%) recovered, although a CNBC headline says Chicago Fed President Goolsbee called the October inflation report 'borderline disturbing' (LRC Market Dashboard, 11 Nov 16:43 SAST; CNBC headline, 11 Nov). The US 10-year yield held at about 5.00%, gold was at $4,033.30 and Brent at $92.84, so higher US rates remain the main pressure on gold, the rand and emerging-market shares (LRC Market Dashboard, 11 Nov 16:43 SAST).

items.title: Nasdaq opens 1.3% higher as AI shares rebound
items.summary: About 13 minutes after the 16:30 SAST open the Nasdaq Composite was at 25,398.80, up 1.3% from Tuesday's 25,065.88 close, and the S&P 500 at 7,584.15, up 0.8% from 7,520.93. CoreWeave was at $56.71 (+16.4%), Micron at $776.10 (+7.0%) and Nvidia at $173.03 (+2.5%). CNBC and MarketWatch headlines say CoreWeave's raised outlook eased worries about an AI spending slowdown. Early-trade levels; they will move before the 23:00 SAST close. We could not open the articles to confirm their figures, so the moves above are from our own price feed only.
items.source: LRC Market Dashboard (Yahoo Finance), 11 Nov 2026 16:43 SAST; LRC Stock Scanner quotes (Yahoo Finance), 11 Nov 2026 16:42 SAST; CNBC and MarketWatch headlines, 11 Nov 2026

items.title: Woolworths down 8.1% into the JSE close
items.summary: Woolworths Holdings was at R37.96 at 16:27 SAST, down 8.1% on the day, slightly weaker than at midday, after a headline on thenational.co.za said its sales had stalled. We could not open the article or the company's update, so no sales figures are given. Woolworths is not on our coverage list.
items.source: LRC Stock Scanner quotes (Yahoo Finance), 11 Nov 2026 16:27 SAST; thenational.co.za headline, 11 Nov 2026

items.title: Fed's Goolsbee calls the October inflation report 'borderline disturbing'
items.summary: A CNBC headline says Chicago Fed President Austan Goolsbee described Tuesday's consumer-price report as 'borderline disturbing' as the central bank weighs more rate hikes. October prices rose 0.4% on the month against 0.3% expected (LRC Macro Desk, BLS, 10 Nov 2026). We could not open the article for his full remarks. The Fed funds target is 3.75%-4.00% (LRC Market Dashboard).
items.source: CNBC headline, 11 Nov 2026 16:24 SAST; LRC Macro Desk (BLS), 10 Nov 2026

items.title: US 10-year yield holds near 5%
items.summary: The US 10-year Treasury yield was 4.998% at 16:43 SAST, little changed from Tuesday's 4.98% close. An Investing.com headline says global bonds fell as the hot US inflation data and Fed comments revived fears of a 0.5 percentage-point hike; we could not open the article to confirm market pricing.
items.source: LRC Market Dashboard (Yahoo Finance), 11 Nov 2026 16:43 SAST; Investing.com headline, 11 Nov 2026

items.title: CoreWeave up 16% after raising its outlook
items.summary: CoreWeave was at $56.71 at 16:43 SAST, up 16.4% from Tuesday's $48.73 close, after the AI cloud company raised its outlook (CNBC headline). A separate CNBC headline says its CEO does not expect the 'new political reality' after the midterms to slow its data-centre build-out. We could not open the articles for the guidance figures.
items.source: LRC Stock Scanner quotes (Yahoo Finance), 11 Nov 2026 16:42 SAST; CNBC headlines, 11 Nov 2026

items.title: Goldman Sachs changes its Fed rate forecast after the hot inflation data
items.summary: MarketWatch reports that Goldman Sachs is changing its Federal Reserve interest-rate forecast after Tuesday's October consumer-price data, and Investing.com headlines say bets on a Fed rate hike have risen. We could not open the articles to confirm what Goldman now expects, so no figures are given.

items.title: Alibaba plans to list its T-Head chip unit
items.summary: Alibaba announced plans to list T-Head, which CNBC describes as a rival to Nvidia in chips.

items.title: JSE All Share slips 0.9% to 113,655 late in the session
items.summary: At 16:27 SAST the All Share was at 113,655.36 and the Top 40 at 105,757.88, both about 0.9% below Tuesday's closes of 114,693.44 and 106,738.05 and lower than at midday. Naspers was at R757.95 (-2.6%), Prosus at R682.51 (-2.3%) and FirstRand at R96.36 (-1.4%), while Glencore (+0.6%) and BHP (+0.4%) were firmer.
items.source: LRC Market Dashboard and LRC Stock Scanner quotes (Yahoo Finance), 11 Nov 2026 16:27-16:43 SAST

items.title: Unemployment rate rises to 33.7% in the third quarter
items.summary: Stats SA's QLFS showed the official unemployment rate up 0.1 percentage point to 33.7% in Q3 2026 from 33.6% in Q2. Employment rose by 101,000 to 16.8 million and formal-sector jobs by 268,000, but the number of unemployed also rose, by 97,000 to 8.6 million, as more people entered the labour force. The expanded (LU3) measure rose to 44.0%; youth unemployment eased to 47.3%. Released Tuesday 10 November (SAnews).

items.title: New fuel prices take effect today
items.summary: Adjusted petrol and diesel prices apply from Wednesday 11 November. IOL reports that part of the relief from lower oil prices is taken up by the new 'Slate levy'; we could not open the article to confirm the cents-per-litre changes, so they are left out.

We could not open the articles for the figures.

items.title: Nvidia rebounds 2.5% after the Baird downgrade
items.summary: Nvidia was at $173.03 at 16:42 SAST, up 2.5% from Tuesday's $168.89 close, after Baird downgraded the stock on worries about CEO Jensen Huang (CNBC headline, 11 Nov). A CNBC headline says the shares are rebounding as Huang faces scrutiny ahead of results on 17 November; we could not open the articles for Baird's new rating or target. Our BUY rating and fair value of $262.56 (LRC Watchlist) are unchanged; a broker downgrade does not change our rating, and the price remains well below that fair value.
items.source: LRC Stock Scanner quotes (Yahoo Finance), 11 Nov 2026 16:42 SAST; CNBC and Moneyweb headlines, 11 Nov 2026; LRC Watchlist

items.title: AMD up 2.2% with the chip rebound
items.summary: AMD was at $526.53 at 16:42 SAST, up 2.2% on the day, as AI-linked chip shares rose after CoreWeave's results (MarketWatch headline). The price is well above our fair value of $402.73; our SELL rating is unchanged (LRC Watchlist).
